description: This Java class is a Spring MVC controller named SystemConfigurationController. It handles HTTP requests related to system configuration management in the admin interface of a web application, specifically displaying and saving system configuration settings.

classes.name: SystemConfigurationController
classes.description: A Spring MVC controller managing system configuration settings in the admin panel.

methods.name: displaySysyemConfgurations
methods.description: Handles GET requests to display current system configurations for a merchant store.

methods.name: saveSystemConfigurations
methods.description: Handles POST requests to save updated system configuration settings for a merchant store.

methods.name: setMenu
methods.description: Sets up the menu state in the model for the configuration pages.
